            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(p => p.style.display = 'none');

        }

            // 1. Enforce authentication on dashboard

            if (!token) {
                window.location.href = '/login?notice=verify_required';

            }

            // 3. Tab routing via URL query parameter

            const targetTab = params.get('tab');

                switchTab('qualificationsTab', document.getElementById('tabBtnQuals'));

                if (input) input.value = certQuery;

            fetchTelemetry();
